expr: (()=>{const ps=[...document.querySelectorAll("#page-eventos .hero .lead")].filter(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().height>0);if(!ps.length)return false;return ps.every(p=>{const w=document.createTreeWalker(p,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);let t;const L={};while((t=w.nextNode())){const re=/\S+/g;let m;while((m=re.exec(t.nodeValue))){const r=document.createRange();r.setStart(t,m.index);r.setEnd(t,m.index+m[0].length);const b=r.getBoundingClientRect();const k=Object.keys(L).find(y=>Math.abs(y-b.top)<5)??b.top;(L[k]||={l:1e9,r:-1e9});L[k].l=Math.min(L[k].l,b.left);L[k].r=Math.max(L[k].r,b.right);}}const ws=Object.values(L).map(x=>x.r-x.l);return ws.length<2||Math.min(...ws)/Math.max(...ws)>=.74})})()
